from datetime import datetime

# Login to phone to get roommate contacts (authoritative)
phone_pw = [p for p in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if p['account_name']=='phone'][0]['password']
phone_login = apis.phone.login(username='9503658964', password=phone_pw)
phone_access_token = phone_login['access_token']

dt = apis.phone.get_current_date_and_time()
# dt['date'] like 'Thursday, May 18, 2023'
year = int(dt['date'].split(',')[-1].strip())
start_date = f"{year}-03-01"
print('start_date', start_date)

# Fetch all roommate contacts (paginated)
roommates = []
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
while True:
    res = apis.phone.search_contacts(access_token=phone_access_token, query='', relationship='roommate', page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    print('roommates page', page_index, 'len', (len(res) if res else 0))
    if not res:
        break
    roommates.extend(res)
    page_index += 1
roommate_emails = [c['email'] for c in roommates if c.get('email')]
print('roommate_emails', roommate_emails)

# Login to Venmo
venmo_pw = [p for p in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if p['account_name']=='venmo'][0]['password']
venmo_login = apis.venmo.login(username='nicholas.weber@gmail.com', password=venmo_pw)
venmo_access_token = venmo_login['access_token']

acct = apis.venmo.show_account(access_token=venmo_access_token)
my_email = acct['email']
print('my_venmo_email', my_email)

# Helper to fetch all transactions between you and user_email since start_date, with direction filter

def fetch_transactions_for_email(user_email, direction):
    txs = []
    page_index = 0
    page_limit = 20
    while True:
        page = apis.venmo.show_transactions(
            access_token=venmo_access_token,
            user_email=user_email,
            min_created_at=start_date,
            direction=direction,
            page_index=page_index,
            page_limit=page_limit
        )
        print('  ', user_email, direction, 'page', page_index, 'len', (len(page) if page else 0))
        if not page:
            break
        txs.extend(page)
        page_index += 1
    return txs

results_by_roommate = {}
for email in roommate_emails:
    sent_txs = fetch_transactions_for_email(email, 'sent')
    received_txs = fetch_transactions_for_email(email, 'received')
    sent_total = sum(float(t['amount']) for t in sent_txs)
    received_total = sum(float(t['amount']) for t in received_txs)
    results_by_roommate[email] = {
        'sent_total': sent_total,
        'received_total': received_total,
        'sent_count': len(sent_txs),
        'received_count': len(received_txs)
    }
    print('summary', email, results_by_roommate[email])

sent_sum = sum(v['sent_total'] for v in results_by_roommate.values())
received_sum = sum(v['received_total'] for v in results_by_roommate.values())
print('TOTAL sent', sent_sum, 'TOTAL received', received_sum, 'NET received-sent', received_sum-sent_sum)
print('results_by_roommate', results_by_roommate)
